# Load libraries

```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(Seurat)
library(SeuratObject)
library(sccomp)
library(edgeR)
library(stringr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggrepel)
library(ggbeeswarm)
library(cowplot)
library(patchwork)
library(egg)
library(Polychrome)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyverse)
library(workflowr)
library(here)
library(sessioninfo)

source(here("code", "helper_functions.R"))
source(here("code", "load_colour_schemes.R"))

RERUN_ALL <- FALSE
```

# Load in the integrated dataset

```{r}
seu_int <- readRDS(here("data", "workflow",
                        "AmnioSC_ALL_optimised_ref.Refined_labels.Seurat.rds"))

seu_int$Donor <- factor(seu_int$Donor)
```

```{r}
# Group samples by gestational age group
seu_int$early_late_gestation <- ifelse(seu_int$gest_age_weeks == 20, "Mid", 
                                       ifelse(seu_int$gest_age_weeks < 20, 
                                              "Early", "Late"))

# remove mid gestation sample for now
seu_int <- seu_int[, seu_int$Donor != "5AF"]
seu_int$Donor <- factor(as.character(seu_int$Donor))
seu_int$Donor.Paper <- factor(as.character(seu_int$Donor.Paper))
seu_int$early_late_gestation <- factor(as.character(seu_int$early_late_gestation))

seu_int$Donor.gest_age <- factor(seu_int$Donor, 
                                 levels = c("4AF", "8AF", "6AF", "1AF", "7AF", "2AF"))
seu_int$Donor.Paper.gest_age <- factor(seu_int$Donor.Paper, 
                                       levels = c("AF_3", "AF_7", "AF_5", "AF_1", "AF_6", "AF_2"))
```

# Pseudobulk Datasets (on counts)

## By donor

```{r}
pseudobulk.Donor <- AggregateExpression(seu_int, 
                                        assays = "RNA", 
                                        slot = "counts",
                                        return.seurat = F, 
                                        group.by = c("Donor.Paper"))

pseudobulk.Donor <- DGEList(pseudobulk.Donor$RNA, 
                            samples=as.character(colnames(pseudobulk.Donor[["RNA"]])))
pseudobulk.Donor

pseudobulk.Donor <- calcNormFactors(pseudobulk.Donor)
pseudobulk.Donor$samples
```

## By refined clusters

```{r}
pseudobulk.refined_clusters <- AggregateExpression(seu_int, 
                                                  assays = "RNA", 
                                                  slot = "counts",
                                                  return.seurat = F, 
                                                  group.by = c("Donor.Paper", "refined_clusters"))

pseudobulk.refined_clusters <- DGEList(pseudobulk.refined_clusters$RNA, 
                                      samples=as.character(colnames(pseudobulk.refined_clusters[["RNA"]])))
pseudobulk.refined_clusters

pseudobulk.refined_clusters <- calcNormFactors(pseudobulk.refined_clusters)
pseudobulk.refined_clusters$samples
```

# MDS Plots (on counts)

## By donor

```{r}
# Generate metadata for plotting
meta.Donor <- seu_int@meta.data %>% group_by(Donor.Paper) %>% 
                  summarise(Donor = unique(Donor.Paper),
                            n_cells = n(),
                            gest_age_weeks = unique(gest_age_weeks),
                            early_late_gestation = unique(early_late_gestation),
                            foetal_sex = unique(foetal_sex),
                            cmv_status = unique(cmv_status),
                            Dataset = unique(Dataset),
                            sample_type = unique(sample_type))
meta.Donor <- as.data.frame(meta.Donor)
rownames(meta.Donor) <- paste(meta.Donor$Donor)
```

```{r}
MDS.Donor <- calcMDS(pseudobulk.Donor, 5, "Donor")
MDS.Donor <- MDS.Donor[meta.Donor$Donor,]
MDS.Donor <- cbind(MDS.Donor, 
                   meta.Donor[, !(colnames(meta.Donor) %in% colnames(MDS.Donor))])

MDS.Donor
```

```{r, fig.width=6, fig.height=6}
plotMDS.Dims1_5(MDS.Donor, "Donor", ALL_DONORS_COLOURS.PAPER, makeFactor = T)

plotMDS.Dims1_5(MDS.Donor, "sample_type", makeFactor = TRUE)
```

## By refined clusters

```{r}
# Generate metadata for plotting
meta.refined_clusters <- seu_int@meta.data %>% group_by(Donor.Paper, refined_clusters) %>% 
                                summarise(Donor = unique(Donor.Paper),
                                          n_cells = n(),
                                          gest_age_weeks = unique(gest_age_weeks),
                                          early_late_gestation = unique(early_late_gestation),
                                          foetal_sex = unique(foetal_sex),
                                          cmv_status = unique(cmv_status),
                                          Dataset = unique(Dataset),
                                          refined_clusters = unique(refined_clusters),
                                          sample_type = unique(sample_type))

meta.refined_clusters <- as.data.frame(meta.refined_clusters)
rownames(meta.refined_clusters) <- paste(meta.refined_clusters$Donor, 
                                        meta.refined_clusters$refined_clusters, sep = "_")
meta.refined_clusters$Donor_Cluster <- rownames(meta.refined_clusters)
```

```{r}
# Perform MDS
MDS.refined_clusters <- calcMDS(pseudobulk.refined_clusters, 5, "Donor_Cluster")
MDS.refined_clusters <- MDS.refined_clusters[meta.refined_clusters$Donor_Cluster,]
MDS.refined_clusters <- cbind(MDS.refined_clusters, 
                             meta.refined_clusters[, !(colnames(meta.refined_clusters) %in%
                                                        colnames(MDS.refined_clusters))])

MDS.refined_clusters
```

# MDS Plots (on proportions)

## By donor

```{r}
# Cluster x Donor matrix of cell counts (using cluster_names)
count_mat <- seu_int@meta.data %>%
  dplyr::count(Donor.Paper, cluster_names) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Donor.Paper, values_from = n, values_fill = 0) %>%
  column_to_rownames("cluster_names") %>%
  as.matrix()

# Treat clusters as "genes" and donors as "samples"
prop_dge <- DGEList(counts = count_mat,
                    samples = data.frame(Donor = colnames(count_mat),
                                         row.names = colnames(count_mat)))
# No TMM normalisation: composition is relative to total cells per donor
prop_dge$samples$norm.factors <- 1
prop_dge$samples

# MDS on log-proportions (cpm with a prior.count to handle zeros)
# NB: calcMDS() uses limma::plotMDS(gene.selection = "common") on log2 CPM
MDS.Donor.prop <- calcMDS(prop_dge, 5, "Donor")
MDS.Donor.prop <- MDS.Donor.prop[meta.Donor$Donor, ]
MDS.Donor.prop <- cbind(MDS.Donor.prop,
                        meta.Donor[, !(colnames(meta.Donor) %in% colnames(MDS.Donor.prop))])

MDS.Donor.prop

saveRDS(MDS.Donor.prop, 
        here("data", "workflow", "AmnioSC.MDS_Donor_Proportions.rds"))
```

```{r, fig.height=10, fig.width=10}
plotMDS.Dims1_5(MDS.Donor.prop, "Donor", ALL_DONORS_COLOURS.PAPER, makeFactor = T)
plotMDS.Dims1_5(MDS.Donor.prop, "Dataset", ALL_DATASETS_COLOURS, makeFactor = T)
plotMDS.Dims1_5(MDS.Donor.prop, "foetal_sex", ALL_FOETAL_SEX_COLOURS, makeFactor = T)
plotMDS.Dims1_5(MDS.Donor.prop, "gest_age_weeks", makeFactor = TRUE)
plotMDS.Dims1_5(MDS.Donor.prop, "early_late_gestation", ALL_GEST_COLOURS)
plotMDS.Dims1_5(MDS.Donor.prop, "cmv_status", makeFactor = TRUE)
plotMDS.Dims1_5(MDS.Donor.prop, "n_cells")
plotMDS.Dims1_5(MDS.Donor.prop, "sample_type", makeFactor = TRUE)
```

# Compare cell type proportions between gestational age groups

```{r, fig.width=16, fig.height=10}
p1 <- seu_int@meta.data %>%
        ggplot(aes(x = factor(gest_age_weeks), fill = cluster_names)) +
        geom_bar() +
        theme_cowplot(12) +
        scale_fill_manual(values = CLUSTER_NAME_COLOURS)  +
        no_legend +
        ggtitle("Number of cells per cluster by gestational age") +
        xlab("Gestational age (weeks)") +
        facet_grid(.~seu_int$Donor.Paper.gest_age, scales = "free", space = "free")

p2 <- seu_int@meta.data %>%
        ggplot(aes(x = factor(gest_age_weeks), fill = cluster_names)) +
        geom_bar(position = "fill") +
        theme_cowplot(12) +
        scale_fill_manual(values = CLUSTER_NAME_COLOURS) +
        guides(fill = guide_legend(ncol = 1)) +
```

# Use `sccomp` to examine cluster proportion changes across gestational age

```{r}
# set it manually so the sccomp functions know where to look
cache_stan_model_dir <- here("renv/library/macos/R-4.5/aarch64-apple-darwin20/sccomp/stan")

# Set the cache directory before any sccomp call (sccomp_boxplot, sccomp_estimate, etc.
# use internal functions that check this cache)
utils::assignInNamespace("sccomp_stan_models_cache_dir", cache_stan_model_dir, ns = "sccomp")
```

```{r}
set.seed(100)
# Fit the sccomp model
# Tests for differences in refined cluster proportions between Early and Late gestation
# Outlier removal is included for robustness
sccomp_result <- seu_int |>
  sccomp_estimate(
    formula_composition = ~ early_late_gestation,
    sample = "Donor",
    cell_group = "cluster_names",
    abundance = "n",
    bimodal_mean_variability_association = TRUE,
    cores = 8,
    verbose = FALSE
  ) |>
  sccomp_remove_outliers(cores = 8, verbose = FALSE) |>
  sccomp_test()
```

```{r}
# View the full results table
# Key columns:
#   c_effect : estimated log-fold change in proportion (Late vs Early)
#   c_pH0    : posterior probability of no effect (lower = more evidence of change)
#   c_FDR    : false discovery rate
sccomp_result

saveRDS(sccomp_result, here("data", "workflow", "AmnioSC.sccomp_result.rds"))
```

```{r}
# Significant clusters (FDR < 0.05)
sccomp_result %>%
  filter(parameter == "early_late_gestationLate",
         c_FDR < 0.05) %>%
  arrange(c_FDR)
```

```{r, fig.width=14, fig.height=8}
# Boxplot: cluster proportions split by gestational age group
sccomp_result |>
  sccomp_boxplot(factor = "early_late_gestation") +
  theme_bw() +
  ggtitle("Cluster proportions by gestational age group (Early vs Late)")
```

```{r}
prop_df <- generateGroupProportionsDF(seu_int, group_var = "cluster_names", donor_var = "Donor.Paper")
```

```{r, fig.width=10, fig.height=10}
ggplot(prop_df, aes(x = early_late_gestation, y = proportion_cluster)) +
  geom_boxplot(aes(fill = early_late_gestation, color = early_late_gestation), 
               alpha = 0.5) + geom_jitter() + theme_bw() + 
  facet_wrap(. ~ cluster_names, scale = "free_y") +
  scale_colour_manual(values = ALL_GEST_COLOURS) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = ALL_GEST_COLOURS) + no_legend
```

```{r}
ggplot(prop_df %>% filter(cluster_names %in% c("ILC3", "Lung epithelium", "Lung epithelium (low confidence)")), 
       aes(x = early_late_gestation, y = proportion_cluster)) +
  geom_boxplot(aes(fill = early_late_gestation, color = "black"), 
               alpha = 0.2) + geom_jitter(aes(color = early_late_gestation)) + theme_bw() + 
  facet_wrap(. ~ cluster_names, scale = "free_y") +
  scale_colour_manual(values = ALL_GEST_COLOURS) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = ALL_GEST_COLOURS) + no_legend
```

```{r, fig.width=10, fig.height=10}
# 1D credible interval plot: effect of gestational age on each cluster
# Clusters whose interval does not cross 0 are significantly different
sccomp_result |>
  plot_1D_intervals() +
  theme_cowplot(12) +
  ggtitle("Effect of gestational age (Late vs Early) on cluster proportions")
```

```{r, fig.width=10, fig.height=10}
# 2D credible interval plot: mean-variability association
# Use this to confirm the bimodal mean-variability assumption is appropriate
# for single-cell RNA-seq data (as recommended in the sccomp vignette)
sccomp_result |>
  plot_2D_intervals()
```
